csv_project_name: Design for SR 2114 McKeesport Duquesne Ramps Deck Replace
csv_scope_of_work: Pennsylvania Department of Transportation may be seeking a Engineering firm to perform preliminary engineering, final design, and services during construction for the SR 2114, Section A07 McKeesport-Duquesne Southern Ramps Deck Replacement project located in the Cities of McKeesport and Duquesne, Allegheny County. The anticipated scope of work may include, but not be limited to: rehabilitation of 5 steel structures in McKeesport (BRKEYs 1666, 1667, 2897, 2899, 2900), preservation of 1 concrete rigid frame structure under fill in McKeesport (BRKEY 2898), preservation of 1 prestressed concrete structure (BRKEY 2869) in Duquesne, potential minor preservation of a second prestressed concrete structure in Duquesne (BRKEY 2868), roadway work, guiderail and end-treatment updates, and miscellaneous construction (signing, pavement markings, drainage, etc.).
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
